questions.q: Which of the following statements is true?
questions.answer: Each amino acid in a protein is coded for by three bases in the DNA.
distractors: Each DNA base codes for three amino acids.
It takes three genes to code for one protein.
Each triplet has many different meanings.
Each gene codes for three proteins.

questions.q: In transcription, how many of the DNA strands are used as the template?
questions.answer: Only one of the DNA strands
distractors: Both DNA strands at the same time
Neither; RNA is copied from another RNA
Neither; the template is a protein

questions.q: In transcription, what acts as the initial binding site for RNA polymerase?
The number of nucleotide bases "read" together on the mRNA to designate each amino acid is _____; this unit is called a(n) _____.
During translation in a eukaryotic cell _____.
questions.answer: polypeptides are synthesized at ribosomes, according to instructions carried by mRNA
distractors: tRNA carries amino acid molecules to the nucleus, where they are added to a growing polypeptide chain
ribosomes move out of the nucleus
mRNA is synthesized by the bonding of free nucleotides to the bases on the template strand of DNA

questions.q: The function of tRNA during protein synthesis is to _____.
questions.answer: deliver amino acids to their proper site during protein synthesis
distractors: attach mRNA to the small subunit of the ribosome
guide ribosome subunits out of the nucleus through nuclear pores

questions.q: In a eukaryotic cell, transcription takes place _____.
What is a key difference in gene expression between eukaryotic and prokaryotic cells?
questions.answer: In prokaryotic cells, the mRNA transcript is immediately available as mRNA without processing.
distractors: In eukaryotic cells, transcribed RNA sequences function as termination signals.
RNA polymerases are involved only in initiation in eukaryotes.
In prokaryotes, proteins are assembled directly from DNA.

questions.q: In a eukaryote, activating transcription factors may stimulate gene expression by binding to a DNA site called a(n) _____.
Which of the following summaries of protein synthesis is correct?
questions.answer: Messenger RNA is made on a DNA template, and then amino-acid-bearing transfer RNAs bind to it through codon-anticodon pairing.
distractors: DNA strands separate in the nucleus to form mRNA. mRNA leaves the nucleus and is transcribed into tRNA on ribosomes.
Transfer RNAs line up on a ribosome, and amino acids bind to them with hydrogen bonds.
DNA exchanges its thymine units with uracil in polymerase. This activates polymerase, and it starts joining amino acids together.
DNA transposons leave the nucleus, are transported to a ribosome, and catalyze the polymerization of amino acids in a protein.

questions.q: What is the proper order of these events in the expression of a eukaryotic gene? (1) translation, (2) RNA processing, (3) transcription, (4) modification of protein
